# mooncake step

Execute a single inline step and return JSON result

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | Show what would be done without making changes |
| `--become / -b` | bool | false | Run step with sudo |
